newsitem.title: UK: Ford to cut 1,500 UK jobs at Halewood -BBC.
newsitem.headline: Ford to cut 1,500 UK jobs at Halewood -BBC.

text.p: US motor firm Ford Motor Co D is to cut 1,500 jobs at its Halewood plant in northwest England, the British Broadcasting Corporation said on Wednesday.
The reduction amounts to one-third of the plant's workforce.
Ford declined to comment on the report.
Ford to cut 1,500 jobs at Halewood =2
Ford was due to hold a meeting with unions led by the Transport and General Workers Union (TGWU) on Thursday morning to discuss the future of the Halewood plant which makes Ford's Escort model.

The company said it would not confirm any reports about possible job losses ahead of this meeting which comes amid rumours of possible closure of the plant and speculation that the new Escort version, due in 1999, would not be built at Halewood.
Analysts said it was unlikely that Ford would take the drastic measure of closing down a plant and axing all 5,000 jobs.
But Halewood is seen by some analysts as one of the least productive Ford plants in Europe.
